Subject: Urgent: Project Submission and Performance Discussion

Hi [Employee Name],

I am writing to address the missed deadline for the recent project submission. This is not the first time this has happened, and it is becoming a recurring pattern.

Meeting deadlines is a fundamental expectation of your role. When these expectations are not met, it impacts the team and the company’s operations. We need to have a serious conversation about your performance and your future with the company if we cannot see an immediate and sustained improvement.

Please let me know your availability for a meeting tomorrow so we can discuss this further and outline the necessary steps to get back on track.

Regards,

[Your Name]
